title: Simplex attachment pushouts for a decomposition simplicial set
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, standard simplices and ordinary nerves from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones] and ordered joins from [def-coef-infinity-relative-cone]. Let $K$ be a small simplicial set, $I$ a small ordinary category and $F:I\to\mathrm{sSet}_{/K}$ a functor, written $a\mapsto(\pi_a:K_a\to K)$. Let $K_F$ be the decomposition simplicial set defined by the two ordered blocks and compatible lifts in [lem-coef-decomposition-local-colimit-cocones]. For a face-stable family of subsets $L_r\subseteq K_r$ (meaning $d_j(L_r)\subseteq L_{r-1}$ for every face), define $L_F\subseteq K_F$ to be the simplicial subset generated by $N(I)$ and by all nondegenerate simplices of $K_F$ with nonempty lower block whose lower $r$-simplex belongs to $L_r$. Fix $m\geq0$ and $\sigma\in K_m\setminus L_m$, assume every proper face of $\sigma$ belongs to $L$, and let $L'$ agree with $L$ except that $L'_m=L_m\cup\{\sigma\}$.

Define $I_\sigma$ to have objects $(a,w)$ with $w\in(K_a)_m$ and $\pi_a(w)=\sigma$, and arrows $(a,w)\to(b,w')$ given by $u:a\to b$ with $F(u)(w)=w'$. Let $D_\sigma$ be the full subcategory on degenerate $w$, where degenerate means the pullback of a smaller-dimensional simplex by a noninjective surjective monotone map. Put $B=N(I_\sigma)$ and $B_0=N(D_\sigma)$. Define $c_\sigma:\Delta^m\star B\to K_F$ on a mixed simplex, consisting of $\alpha:[r]\to[m]$ and a chain $(a_0,w_0)\to\cdots\to(a_s,w_s)$, by lower block $\alpha^*\sigma$, upper chain $a_0\to\cdots\to a_s$, and lifts $\alpha^*w_j$. On the pure lower factor it is $\sigma:\Delta^m\to K$, and on the pure upper factor it is the forgetful map $B\to N(I)$. This is a simplicial map with image in $L'_F$.

If $\sigma$ is nondegenerate, $c_\sigma$ sends $\partial\Delta^m\star B$ into $L_F$ and the square
$$\begin{array}{ccc}\partial\Delta^m\star B&\hookrightarrow&\Delta^m\star B\\ \downarrow&&\downarrow c_\sigma\\ L_F&\hookrightarrow&L'_F\end{array}$$
is a pushout in simplicial sets.

If $\sigma$ is degenerate, put
$$P_\sigma=(\partial\Delta^m\star B)\amalg_{\partial\Delta^m\star B_0}(\Delta^m\star B_0)\subseteq\Delta^m\star B.$$
Then $c_\sigma$ sends $P_\sigma$ into $L_F$ and the square
$$\begin{array}{ccc}P_\sigma&\hookrightarrow&\Delta^m\star B\\ \downarrow&&\downarrow c_\sigma\\ L_F&\hookrightarrow&L'_F\end{array}$$
is a pushout in simplicial sets. Here $\partial\Delta^m$ is the simplicial subset of $\Delta^m$ consisting of monotone maps with nonsurjective image; in particular $\partial\Delta^0=\varnothing$, and $X\star\varnothing=X$, so $\Delta^m\star B_0$ contains the pure lower factor even when $B_0$ is empty. Neither the maps $\pi_a$ nor $c_\sigma$ are required to be injective. No contractibility, weak homotopy equivalence, directedness or quasicategory assumption is imposed.

from.place: Auxiliary HTT Proposition 5.3.5.15, proof (a), reduction to the lifting tests N(B) ⊆ N(B ∪ {∞}) using Remark 5.3.1.12: the converse direction of Remark 5.3.1.12, cofinal poset-nerve replacement of a κ-small diagram shape (Variants 4.2.3.15, 4.2.3.16). Supporting input: HTT Proposition 4.2.3.14 and its last-vertex construction in Lemma 4.2.3.13, printed pp. 254-255; Proposition 4.1.1.7, printed p. 226, for the fiberwise cocone assertion; compare the natural join/cocone equivalence of lem-coef-join-slice-cocone-comparison. Specifically the application of HTT Proposition 4.2.3.8 in the proof of Proposition 4.2.3.14: the inclusion of the indexing nerve in the decomposition simplicial set. Structural input: the two simplex-attachment pushout squares in the proof of HTT Proposition 4.2.3.8, printed p. 252; no contractibility or weak-equivalence hypotheses.
